heading: Your account
title: Account
askIntro: This is the name on your account.
firstTimeIntro: This is the name on your account. You can change it later.
offline: You are offline. You can change your name when you are connected.
saveFailed: We couldn't save your name. You can try again.
sessionEnded: You've been signed out. Your work on this device is safe. Sign in again when you're ready.
checklistNote: Not today. Just so none of it surprises you.
securityHint: Change your email, password or the devices signed in to your account.
signOutHint: Your work stays on this device. You can sign in again when you are ready.
planBody: There is nothing to pay today.
cardNotOpen: Adding a card is not open yet.
birthDateHint: Optional. Only you can see this.
birthDateIncomplete: Please enter the whole date, with the year. For example, May 29, 1980.
birthDateOutOfRange: Please check the date. It can't be in the future or before 1900.
detailsInvalid: We couldn't save that. Please check your details and try again.
plansHint: Save what you have written as a text file. You can print it or share it. It is made on this device. Contacts are not in it.
plansDownloaded: A copy was made. Check your downloads.
plansNone: There is nothing to save yet.
phoneBody: Sending happens in the Grievers Guidance phone app, not on this page.
phoneNotInStores: The app is not in the app stores yet.
phoneNoneReady: Nothing is marked ready yet. When a part is ready, it will be listed here.
supportBody: Write to us if you have a question or something is not working.
deleteHint: This deletes your account, every person and plan, and the messages they wrote. People helping you lose access. It cannot be undone.
deleteConfirmBody: Your account, every person and plan, and the messages they wrote will be deleted. People helping you will lose access. This cannot be undone.
deleteFailed: We could not finish deleting your account. Please try again, or write to us for help.
deletedBody: What you saved is being removed from our servers.
deletedLeftover: Some things could not be removed from this device.
personalHint: Your first name signs your messages. The rest is only for you.
askNamesIntro: Your first name is the name your messages are signed with.
fieldTooLong: That is too long. Please shorten it.
fieldBadChars: Please enter this on one line, with no hidden characters.
addressHint: Optional. If you add an address, please fill in every line except line 2.
stateHint: Two letters, for example NJ, or the full name.
stateInvalid: Please use the two-letter state code, for example NJ.
zipInvalid: Please enter a ZIP code like 07001 or 07001-1234.
checkFields: Please check the fields with a message under them.
